description:
Return a secret, short-lived GET URL for an object's bytes.

The returned URL starts with https://s3.ironshard.ai. If outgoing requests are restricted by a network whitelist, this domain must be added to it before the URL can be used.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.

object_key.description: Complete object key, including path-like prefixes.

name: get_download_url

outputSchema.description: A short-lived URL and the HTTP method required to use it.

http_method.description: HTTP method that must be used with the presigned URL.

url.description: Short-lived presigned HTTPS URL containing all authorization information.

title: Get Download Url
